scope: Owner-authorized preparation of the five installed non-PuriPuly applications, followed by application shutdown. One initial profile per application, not simultaneous preparation of every alternate profile.

backup.contents: Original byte-for-byte configurations; contain secrets and must remain private.

method.primary: Actual Windows GUI using computer screenshots, accessibility controls and native keyboard input.
file_exceptions: Before VRCLS launch, disabled autoStartMic and controlAutoStart to prevent automatic recognition.
Before VRCLT launch, disabled dashboard translation, outbound, inbound and control flags. outbound.enabled alone does not stop the product's outbound capture/passthrough pipeline.
VRCS 0.2.2 exposes chatbox and mute switches but no OSC destination-port input in the inspected Connections/Debug pages. Changed osc.port while the app was stopped.

Before reopening VRCLT, selected CABLE Output input and Realtek Digital Output playback in the file to prevent private-microphone capture and CABLE feedback during GUI configuration. Both were subsequently displayed in the GUI.
method.window_management_fallback: After computer window-target failures and control-confirmation timeouts, used normal CloseMainWindow requests and, following the owner's explicit refocus request, ShowWindow/SetForegroundWindow on the existing owned windows. No replacement app instance was used to work around a running instance.

applications.whisper_base_assets: Previously confirmed present; not the active ASR selection.
applications.gui_final_state: Translation, microphone recognition, speaker recognition and chat reading switches were off.
applications.save_evidence: Read-back of selected device, language maps, engines, CPU descriptors and explicit OSC Save action; port read back as 19111.

applications.gui_final_state: Start transcription remained available; no transcription start was requested.
applications.limits: Existing credentials were reused without editing them. Validity, quota/project isolation and the planned free-route claim remain unverified. Qwen CPU profile was not activated or downloaded. Destination-port change has saved-file evidence, not a live packet observation.

applications.gui_final_state: Microphone and monitor controls displayed stopped; language route and OSC port were displayed in Settings.
applications.save_evidence: Settings window was closed to commit changes; config read-back confirmed English to Japanese, no second/third targets, cable, dedicated port and disabled autostarts.

applications.gui_final_state: START button and empty message history after explicitly stopping the initial automatic startup state.
applications.startup_caveat: First launch displayed STOP before an operator start request. It was immediately stopped when observed. No message history was visible, but absence of automatic network/recognition activity was not established.

applications.gui_final_state: Text-only checked, CABLE Output selected, subtitles OFF, waiting/raw-passthrough rather than translation mode. Settings Save and Restart completed; no audio pilot was run.
applications.startup_caveat: The first guarded launch retained the old microphone/playback routing. Source inspection confirms translation OFF does not disable raw microphone passthrough and outbound.enabled is not a capture stop. Runtime audio delivery during that initial launch was not measured. Before reopening, input/output routing was guarded and then displayed in the GUI.
applications.save_evidence: Saved YAML read-back confirmed source en, target ja, Qwen Beijing model, text-only normalization, safe non-injection playback, disabled inbound/control/overlays, port 19132 and unchanged 15-second idle timeout.

verification_boundary.post_exit_saved_state_checks: Passed for all five configurations; VRCLT redacted projection remained unchanged after exit.
verification_boundary.owned_process_shutdown: Confirmed all tracked VRCT, VRCS, VRCLS, kikitan/overlay and VRCLT processes exited after normal close requests.
verification_boundary.catalogue_smoke: python -m bench.cli profiles exited 0 with all 14 profiles still blocked and no readiness promotion.
